audit: masked-mean query feature consistency for repeated exact normalized text in strict inner Novel-dev
interpretation: The row-cached query feature vector is not bit-identical for repeated identical text. Consequently, the empirical query-only same-query PairAcc can drift from 0.5 (A1=0.640, C1=0.488) despite no video input. Treat query-only pooled AUROC as a prior diagnostic, but do not interpret that conditional value as semantic query compatibility. A deterministic one-vector-per-text embedding control should be used in later pilots. This does not use labels to select or alter predictions.
